scripts.dev:services:db:up: docker inspect spliit-db >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker start spliit-db || docker run -d --name spliit-db -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=1234 -e PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata -v $PWD/../../storage/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16-alpine && until docker exec spliit-db pg_isready -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done
